High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 482 of B.N.S.S. for grant of anticipatory bail apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.364/2019 at Police Station Lalbarra, District Balaghat (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 419, 420, 467, 468, 471,
120-B of IPC.

The first application of applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 03.11.2025 passed in MCRC. No.48837/2025.
2.

As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that he committed fraud by impersonating some other person in his place in the Sub Inspector (Computer)/Head Constable (Computer) /Police Constable Recruitment Test - 2016.

entities.text: Sub Inspector (Computer)/Head Constable (Computer) /Police Constable Recruitment Test - 2016
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Therefore, the offence has been registered against the present applicant under the aforesaid section.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-JBP:101 2 MCRC-57154-2025 and has been falsely implicated in the present case.

It is submitted that the only allegation against the applicant is that his fingerprint is not matched in the biometric system and for that purpose custodial interrogation of the applicant is not necessary.
The applicant is ready to cooperate in the investigation.

In support of his submission, learned counsel for applicant has placed reliance on the decision of Gujarat High Court in Hasmukhbhai Rambhai Patel vs. State of Gujarat passed in R/Criminal Misc. Application No.11254/2020.

entities.text: Hasmukhbhai Rambhai Patel vs. State of Gujarat
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be granted anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Shishuraj Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant and has submitted that earlier anticipatory bail application was dismissed as withdrawn when this Court was not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant and after rejection of the same, there is no change in the circumstances of the case.

It is also submitted that the allegation against the applicant is that he impersonated some other person in his place in the Sub Inspector (Computer)/Head Constable (Computer) /Police Constable Recruitment Test - 2016.

entities.text: Sub Inspector (Computer)/Head Constable (Computer) /Police Constable Recruitment Test - 2016
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the enquiry it was found that the fingerprint of present applicant and the person who appeared in the examination are differ.
The custodial interrogation of the applicant is also required in this case.

Hence, the applicant does not deserve grant of anticipatory bail.
5.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6. Looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case as well as act of applicant, I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:101 3 MCRC-57154-2025 7.
Accordingly, present MCRC for grant of anticipatory bail stands dismissed.
